definition_en: a group of people born around the same time, or the act of producing something
core_image: 祖孙三代人站在一起，时间像河流一样从他们身边流过
scene: 爷爷那一代人经历了巨大的变化。My grandfather's generation saw great changes.

senses.title: People of one age
senses.definition: all the people born and living at about the same time
senses.definitionCN: 大约在同一时期出生并生活的一批人
senses.example: My grandfather's generation saw great changes.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷那一代人经历了巨大的变化。
senses.why: The word first names a batch of people produced by one period.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指同一个时期「产生」出来的一批人。

senses.title: Producing
senses.definition: the act or process of producing something such as power or heat
senses.definitionCN: 生产电力、热量等事物的行为或过程
senses.example: The generation of electricity from sunlight is growing.
senses.exampleCN: 利用阳光发电正在增长。

senses.whyCN: 原本「生育」的含义扩展到了任何形式的产生。

senses.title: A span of about thirty years
senses.definition: a period of about thirty years, or one stage in a family's history
senses.definitionCN: 大约三十年的时间，或家族历史中的一个阶段
senses.example: The story covers three generations of one family.
senses.exampleCN: 这个故事讲了一个家族三代人的经历。
senses.why: A new batch of people arrives roughly every thirty years.
senses.whyCN: 大约每三十年就会有新的一批人长大成人。

definition_en: a machine or person that produces something, especially electricity

senses.whyCN: 在生物学中，属是物种所归属的类别。

definition_en: in a way that gives more than is expected

branches.en: A rare day lives up to its name.

intro.en: Genuinely is the adverb form of the genuine family.

definition_en: the study of the earth and its places, or the layout of an area

senses.title: Study of the earth

senses.example: She studied geography at university.

senses.title: Layout of things

core.en: The earth described and mapped.

branches.en: A student traces rivers on a wall map.

branches.en: Hills and a wide valley shape the weather.

branches.en: Shops spread across a city in a pattern.

definition_en: the study of shapes, sizes, and space, or the shape of something
core_image: 一块黑板上画着三角形、圆和交叉的直线
scene: 学生们在几何课上画三角形。The students drew triangles in geometry class.

senses.title: Study of shapes

senses.definitionCN: 研究点、线、角和形状的数学分支
senses.example: The students drew triangles in geometry class.

senses.why: Geometry began as the measuring of land.

senses.title: Layout in space

senses.definitionCN: 事物在空间中的排列方式
senses.example: The geometry of the streets guides traffic.

scene: 用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。Washing hands with soap removes germs.

senses.title: Tiny living cause
senses.definition: a very small living thing, especially one that causes disease
senses.definitionCN: 极小的生物，尤指引起疾病的微生物
senses.example: Washing hands with soap removes germs.
senses.exampleCN: 用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。
senses.why: The seed sense was borrowed for unseen living particles.

senses.title: First seed of an idea

senses.definitionCN: 想法或感情最初微小的开端

intro.cn: germ 最初指幼芽，后来被用来指微生物。

intro.cn: gesture 来自拉丁语中表示承载和身体姿态的词。

items.en: Gerere meant to carry or perform.
items.cn: gerere 意为承载或施行。

items.en: Gestus meant a bearing or movement of the body.
items.cn: gestus 意为身体的姿态或动作。

items.en: Gestura named the making of such movements.
items.cn: gestura 指做出这类动作。

items.en: English used gesture for expressive body movement.
items.cn: 英语用 gesture 指富有表现力的身体动作。

items.en: It widened to symbolic acts and then to a verb.
items.cn: 它的含义扩展到象征性举动，后来又变成动词。

note.en: Gesture is compared with look-alike words and words for signs and movements.

abstract.en: A gesture is a promise made visible.
abstract.cn: 姿态是一个看得见的承诺。

abstract.en: What the body says, the mouth often repeats.
abstract.cn: 身体说过的话，嘴常常再说一遍。

definition_en: to obtain something, to become a certain way, to reach a place, or to understand
core_image: 一双手终于接到从空中抛来的钥匙
scene: 她终于得到了那份工作。She finally got the job she wanted.
sceneCN: 这里 get 是「得到；获得」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她终于得到了那份工作。

senses.title: Obtain
senses.definition: to receive or obtain something
senses.definitionCN: 接到或获得某物
senses.example: She finally got the job she wanted.
senses.exampleCN: 她终于得到了那份想要的工作。
senses.why: This is the oldest core sense: to come to have something.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的核心义：使某物来到自己手中。

senses.title: Become
senses.definition: to become or start to be in a certain state
senses.definitionCN: 变成或开始处于某种状态
senses.example: It gets cold here after sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 这里日落后会变冷。
senses.why: Coming to have a state is like coming to have a thing.
senses.whyCN: 「进入某种状态」就像「得到某样东西」。

senses.title: Reach
senses.definition: to arrive at a place or reach a point
senses.definitionCN: 到达某地或抵达某个位置
senses.example: We got home before the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在下雨前到了家。
senses.why: Arriving is obtaining a place with your body.
senses.whyCN: 抵达就是用身体「获得」一个位置。

senses.title: Understand
senses.definition: to understand something, especially a joke or idea
senses.definitionCN: 理解某事，尤指笑话或想法
senses.example: I get the point now.
senses.exampleCN: 我现在明白这个意思了。
senses.why: To get an idea is to take hold of it with the mind.
senses.whyCN: 「得到」一个想法，就是用头脑把它抓住。

intro.en: Get came from Old Norse and spread into many meanings in English.
intro.cn: get 来自古诺斯语，在英语中扩展出许多含义。

items.en: Geta meant to obtain or reach.
items.cn: geta 意为获得或到达。

items.en: The verb entered English as geten.
items.cn: 这个动词以 geten 进入英语。

items.en: It covered obtaining, seizing, and arriving.
items.cn: 它涵盖获得、抓取和到达。

items.en: It developed the sense of becoming.
items.cn: 它发展出「变得」的含义。

items.en: It also came to mean understanding.
items.cn: 它也开始表示理解。

note.en: Get is compared with look-alike words and verbs of obtaining.
note.cn: 把 get 与形近词以及表示获得的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Get is the everyday verb for coming to have something.

normal.cn: 她终于得到了那份想要的工作。

normal.en: I get the point now.
normal.cn: 我现在明白这个意思了。

normal.en: Let us get ready for the trip.
normal.cn: 我们为旅行做好准备吧。

abstract.en: To get is to close the distance between want and hand.
abstract.cn: 得到，就是缩短愿望与手之间的距离。

abstract.en: Some things are got by waiting, others by walking.
abstract.cn: 有些东西靠等待得到，有些靠走过去得到。

abstract.en: Understanding is getting an idea to stay.
abstract.cn: 理解，就是让一个想法留下来。

examples.en: She finally got the job she wanted.
examples.cn: 她终于得到了那份想要的工作。

examples.en: I get the point now.

dict_mnemonic.text: get 是英语里含义最广的动词之一：得到、变得、到达、理解都可用它；get ready 是「准备好」，get rid of 是「摆脱」，get to 是「到达」。

root: 来自古诺斯语 geta（获得、到达），进入英语后含义大幅扩展，核心义「使某物来到自己这里」。

sensesIntro.en: Get means to obtain, to become, to reach, or to understand.
sensesIntro.cn: get 意为得到、变得、到达或理解。

core.en: Bringing something into your possession or reach.
core.cn: 把某物带入自己的掌握或触及范围。

branches.en: A hand closes around a key.
branches.cn: 一只手合拢，握住一把钥匙。

branches.en: The evening air turns cool.
branches.cn: 傍晚的空气变凉了。

branches.en: A traveller steps through the front door.

branches.en: A joke lands and the listener smiles.

branches.en: Holding a thing and holding an idea use the same verb.

latinIntro.en: Get has no Latin root; it came from Old Norse.

scene: 老房子里据说有鬼魂出没。The old house is said to be haunted by a ghost.

senses.title: Spirit of the dead
senses.definition: the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see
senses.definitionCN: 有人认为能看见的死者灵魂
senses.example: The old house is said to be haunted by a ghost.
senses.exampleCN: 老房子里据说有鬼魂出没。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the soul or spirit that outlives the body.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是离开身体后仍然存在的灵魂。

senses.title: A faint trace
senses.definition: a very slight remaining trace of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物保留下来的极其微弱的痕迹

senses.whyCN: 一丝痕迹就像几乎消散的幽灵。

senses.title: Write for another
senses.definition: to write a book or speech for another person who is named as the author
senses.definitionCN: 替署名的他人撰写书或演讲稿
senses.example: He ghosted the general's memoirs.
senses.exampleCN: 他替将军代笔写回忆录。
senses.why: The real writer stays invisible, like a ghost.
senses.whyCN: 真正的写作者隐身不见，就像幽灵。

intro.en: Ghost descends from an Old English word for spirit or soul.
intro.cn: ghost 源自古英语中表示灵魂或精神的词。

core.en: A presence without a solid body.

branches.en: A curtain moves in an empty room.

branches.en: A smile appears and almost vanishes.

senses.definitionCN: 想象中体型和力量极大的存在

definition_en: something given to someone without payment, or a natural ability
core_image: 一个包着彩纸的盒子被双手递到另一双手中
scene: 她给孩子买了一份生日礼物。She bought a birthday gift for the child.
sceneCN: 这里 gift 是「礼物」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她给孩子买了一份生日礼物。

senses.title: Something given
senses.definition: something given to someone without payment, often for a special occasion
senses.definitionCN: 无偿送给别人的东西，常在特殊场合赠送
senses.example: She bought a birthday gift for the child.
senses.exampleCN: 她给孩子买了一份生日礼物。
senses.why: The original sense is simply something handed over as a favour.
senses.whyCN: 最初的含义就是出于好意递给别人的东西。

senses.title: Natural ability
senses.definition: a natural ability that someone is born with
senses.definitionCN: 与生俱来的能力
senses.example: She has a gift for languages.
senses.exampleCN: 她有语言天赋。
senses.why: A talent was seen as something given by nature.
senses.whyCN: 天赋被看作是大自然赠予的东西。

senses.title: The act of giving
senses.definition: the act of giving something formally to another
senses.definitionCN: 正式把某物赠与他人的行为
senses.example: The land came to the town by gift.
senses.exampleCN: 这块土地是通过赠与归城镇所有的。
senses.why: The object and the act of handing it over share one word.
senses.whyCN: 所赠之物与赠予行为共用同一个词。

intro.en: Gift came from the Norse word for a present or favour.
intro.cn: gift 来自诺斯语中表示礼物或恩惠的词。

items.en: Gipt meant a gift or a piece of luck.
items.cn: gipt 意为礼物或好运。

items.en: Gift first named a dowry or marriage gift.
items.cn: gift 最初指嫁妆或婚姻赠礼。

items.en: It widened to any present.
items.cn: 它扩展为任何礼物。

items.en: It came to mean a natural ability.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示天赋。

items.en: The verb gift named the formal act of giving.
items.cn: 动词 gift 指正式的赠予行为。

note.en: Gift is compared with look-alike words and words for presents and abilities.
note.cn: 把 gift 与形近词以及表示礼物和能力词作比较。

entries.definition: money or goods given to a cause

normalIntro.en: A gift moves from one pair of hands to another with no price attached.
normalIntro.cn: gift 从一双手移到另一双手，却不带价格。

normal.en: She bought a birthday gift for the child.
normal.cn: 她给孩子买了一份生日礼物。

normal.en: She has a gift for languages.
normal.cn: 她有语言天赋。

normal.en: The land came to the town by gift.
normal.cn: 这块土地是通过赠与归城镇所有的。

normal.en: He found a gift shop near the station.
normal.cn: 他在车站附近找到一家礼品店。

normal.en: The free gift came with the magazine.
normal.cn: 这份赠品随杂志附送。

abstract.en: The best gift is the one the giver also needed.
abstract.cn: 最好的礼物，是送礼人自己也需要的那个。

abstract.en: Talent is a gift that still asks for practice.
abstract.cn: 天赋是一份仍然要求练习的礼物。

abstract.en: What is given with love arrives twice.
abstract.cn: 带着爱给出的东西，会到达两次。

dict_mnemonic.text: gift 与 give（给）同源：给出去的东西就是「礼物」，老天给的能力就是「天赋」；a gift for 是「……的天赋」，gift shop 是「礼品店」。

root: 来自古诺斯语 gipt（礼物、好运），与 give 同源，核心义「无偿给予的东西」。

sensesIntro.en: Gift means something given without payment, a natural ability, or the act of giving.
sensesIntro.cn: gift 意为无偿赠送的东西、天赋，或赠与的行为。

core.en: Something handed over with no price.
core.cn: 不带价格地递出去的东西。

branches.en: A wrapped box passes across a table.
branches.cn: 一个包好的盒子从桌子一端递到另一端。

branches.en: A child plays a tune after hearing it once.
branches.cn: 孩子只听一遍就能把曲子弹出来。

branches.en: Land is handed to a town by agreement.
branches.cn: 土地依照协议被交给一座城镇。

branches.en: A present and a talent are both things received.
branches.cn: 礼物与天赋都是被接收的东西。

branches.en: Giving and being gifted share one idea of handing over.
branches.cn: 给予与有天赋共享「递出」这一个概念。

intro.en: Gift builds a family about presents, talents, and giving.
intro.cn: gift 构成一组关于礼物、天赋与给予的词。

latinIntro.en: Gift has no Latin root; it came from Old Norse gipt.
latinIntro.cn: gift 没有拉丁词根，它来自古诺斯语 gipt。

items.example: The gift was wrapped in blue.
items.exampleCN: 礼物用蓝色纸包着。
桌上堆满了礼物。
她是一位有天赋的钢琴家。

items.example: The school looks for giftedness in music.
items.exampleCN: 这所学校在音乐方面寻找天赋。
婚礼上送礼很常见。

items.meaning: to wrap something as a present
items.exampleCN: 能把这个包装成礼物吗？
这家店卖礼品。

items.meaning: to give a received gift to someone else
items.exampleCN: 他把那条围巾转赠了出去。

definition_en: a female child or young woman, or someone's daughter
core_image: 一个扎着辫子的小女孩在草地上追着风筝跑
scene: 那个女孩在公园里放风筝。The girl flew a kite in the park.
sceneCN: 这里 girl 是「女孩」（第 1 个义项）；句意：那个女孩在公园里放风筝。

senses.title: Female child
senses.definition: a female child or young person
senses.definitionCN: 女性的孩子或年轻人
senses.example: The girl flew a kite in the park.
senses.exampleCN: 那个女孩在公园里放风筝。
senses.why: This is the central everyday sense of the word today.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词今天最核心的日常含义。

senses.title: Daughter
senses.definition: someone's daughter, especially a young one
senses.definitionCN: 某人的女儿，尤指年幼的女儿
senses.example: Their girl is starting school this year.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的女儿今年开始上学。
senses.why: Parents often name a daughter simply as their girl.
senses.whyCN: 父母常常简单地把女儿称作「自家的女孩」。

senses.title: Young woman
senses.definition: a young woman, especially in informal use
senses.definitionCN: 年轻女性，尤用于非正式场合
senses.example: A group of girls waited outside the cinema.
senses.exampleCN: 一群姑娘在电影院外等候。
senses.why: The word widened from children to young women.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从孩子扩展到了年轻女性。

intro.en: The origin of girl is uncertain; it first meant a young person of either sex.
intro.cn: girl 的来源不确定，它最初指任何性别的年轻人。

items.en: The word appears in Middle English with no clear parent.
items.cn: 这个词在中古英语中出现，没有明确的来源。

items.en: Gurle meant a child or young person.
items.cn: gurle 意为孩子或年轻人。

items.en: It could name a boy or a girl.
items.cn: 它可以指男孩，也可以指女孩。

items.en: It settled on a female child.
items.cn: 它固定下来指女性的孩子。

items.en: It widened again to young women.
items.cn: 它又扩展到年轻女性。

note.en: Girl is compared with look-alike words and words for young females.
note.cn: 把 girl 与形近词以及表示年轻女性的词作比较。

dict_mnemonic.text: girl 最初在中古英语里指「年轻人」，男女都能用，后来才专指女孩；little girl 是「小女孩」，school girl 是「女学生」，girlfriend 是「女朋友」。

sensesIntro.cn: girl 意为女孩、某人的女儿，或年轻女子。
